decision.reason: [ev-ddf5fd344d03] says only that support for Consul, deprecated since v1.12, has been removed. It does not say what happens to a deployment still configured for Consul. The settings might be ignored, the agent might fail to start, or the upgrade might be blocked. The proposed workload-failure statement and its 'state synchronization' framing are not in the evidence. To decide the consequence kind, we need evidence that names the Consul configuration (flags or keys) and says what Cilium 1.17 does when they are set.
